title: Rappler Recap: Sara Duterte’s grave threats arraignment postponed again
summary: What are the reasons behind this second postponement? Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo explains in this recap.

blocks.text: What are the reasons behind this second postponement? Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo explains in this recap.

MANILA, Philippines – The arraignment of Vice President Sara Duterte’s grave threats case has been postponed again on Friday, October 10, pending the resolution of her appeal before a Quezon City court.
Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo explains in this recap. – Rappler.com
